description:
A share is emitted only for a type that can carry a mark, and it is inline.

Today (machine.md M1, runtime.md R2, compiler.md C6):
- fz_mark_published_ref_aliased is 42 instructions per call: a dead panic Location, two tag decodes, and a stack Result round trip.
- For a binary it does nothing. Heap::share acts only on LIST and STRUCT (heap/imp.rs:1273-1278).
- Count per operation: byte_size 1, <> with a variable 2, a == b 4 (2 of them re-sharing loop-invariant parameters at the self-tail-call back edge), send 1.

Cause: construct_call_ownership (src/compiler2/jobs/body.rs:4486-4540) picks Share regardless of type. The tuple items (native.rs:1216) and closure captures (:1399) do the same. prim.rs:1176 tests only the representation.

Fix:
- Choose Share only for types that can carry a mark (today list, tuple, struct).
- Where the type is open, the test (tag in {LIST, STRUCT}) and the mark store are inline.
- Do not re-share a lane received unchanged at a self-tail-call back edge.
- The extern, if any remains, is infallible.

COORDINATE with Optimize: this is ticket 2b of fz-nml.29's private-append page ("a share is one store"). When binaries gain a mark under nml.29, "types that carry a mark" grows to include them. Agree the seam and landing order with Optimize before building; do not land a version nml.29 must undo.

Asm first: target listings for byte_size(b), a == b and acc <> x with no share, and for an open-typed lane with the inline test.

Acceptance: probe slopes fall by 42 per share removed (byte_size 95 -> ~53, == loses 168), judged on bench.
title: A share is emitted only for a type that can carry a mark, and it is inline
